deviations.claim_in_article: Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.
deviations.issue: The statement generalizes the observed price movement beyond Brent crude futures to the oil market as a whole; the Ledger only reports the Brent futures reaction.
deviations.explanation: The Ledger’s observation concerns Brent futures, while this claim extends the conclusion to the whole oil market. This is a scope change. The same broad claim appears in the Japanese source.
